payload.core_mechanism_summary: Precompute sorted missing numbers, then greedily assign: when MEX increases, output previous MEX; else output next missing number.
payload.rationale: The solution constructs b by iterating through a and deciding based on whether a_i changed. The sorted missing numbers (ans) are used to pad when MEX stays same. This fits greedy_sorting_order as the key step is precomputing sorted missing numbers and greedily assigning them.
